51490809.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length Mycobacterium tuberculosis protein kinase G expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 assessed as apparent dissociation constant at 44 degreeC by isothermal titration calorimetry
51490809.references_previous: Paketuryte, V.; Petruska, V.; Zubriene, A.; Abian, O.; Bastos, M.; Chen, W.-Y.; Moreno, M. J.; Krainer, G.; Linkuviene, V.; Sedivy, A.; et al. Asymmetric Confidence Intervals for Protein-Ligand Binding Constants: A New Approach. Sci. Rep. 2021, 11, 9572.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - ITC Measurements: 4.2.7. Isothermal Titration Calorimetry. ITC experiments for ligands T1 and B1 were performed in a MicroCal-PeaQ ITC instrument. To prevent possible solubility issues, the ligands were incubated in the cell, and the protein (PknG kinase domain) was injected. The injections regime consisted of one small injection of 0.4 μL and 11 injections of 3.5 μL. The injection time was 0.8 s for the first injection and 7 s for the rest. The injection time between injections was 5 min, and the stirring speed was set to 300 RPM. All ITC runs were performed at 25 °C. For T1, the protein concentration was 350 μM and the ligand concentration was 60 μM. For B1, the protein concentration was 330 μM and the ligand concentration was 35 μM. To prevent buffer mismatch, the ligands were diluted from pure DMSO to 1% v/v using the SEC buffer from the purification. DMSO was added to the protein sample to achieve the same concentration. Raw thermograms were analyzed using a custom R script provided in the Supporting Information (one-to-one binding model with subtraction of control titration). Asymmetric confidence intervals were calculated as previously mentioned.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. Binding affinity characterization and holo-structure of ligand B1. (A,B) Estimation of the equilibrium dissociation constant Kd from intrinsic fluorescence spectroscopy and ITC, respectively. (C,D) Estimation of the apparent equilibrium dissociation constant Kd from isothermal analysis of melting curves and observed melting temperature shift analysis, respectively. (E) Crystal structure of the PknG–ligand B1 complex (PDBid 7Q52).

original_paragraph.Supporting Information Note: For compounds T1, T2, B1, S1, S2, and AX20017, the volume of the solutions was between 85 and 95 μL (Greiner 96-well flat transparent plate). For compounds B2, B3, and B4, we used 25/28 μL (Greiner 384-well flat black plate). The fluorescence signal was fitted to a one-site binding model using the ThermoAffinity online tool. Asymmetric confidence intervals were calculated as suggested by Paketuryte et al., 2021.39
